verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a sandbox, described as a self-contained virtual testing environment that simulates live production. Its developer tooling, including the local MCP server's PAYPAL_ENVIRONMENT setting, the remote sandbox MCP endpoint and toolkit guidance to test in sandbox, targets that environment. The pack never mentions test cards or ways to simulate declines and disputes, so only the environment half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented test card numbers, decline/error scenario simulation, dispute simulation in sandbox, independent corroboration that the sandbox mirrors production.
